# Introduction

This project examines associations between sex and COVID-19 clinical outcomes among patients in Mexico. We analyze a 20% subset of the original COVID-19 dataset.

# Data and Methods

The dataset contains patient demographic and clinical information. Each coder examines an assigned COVID-19 outcome using summary tables, visualizations, and statistical tests.
